'''''Star Wars: The High Republic''''' is a [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] series written by [[Cavan Scott]] and published by [[Marvel Comics]]. The series is part of the ''[[Star Wars: The High Republic]]'' multimedia project, and was the flagship comic series for the project's second phase. The first issue of the series was published on [[October 12]], [[2022]].
